name: Colour Cards
description: Get rid of your cards. Match the top of the discard pile by colour or by number or symbol, or play a wild and name the colour. Skip misses the next player, Reverse turns play round, +2 and +4 make the next player draw and miss their turn. Draw a card if you can't (or won't) play; you may play it at once. Call "Last card!" before playing your second-last card, or draw two.
